senses.gloss:
छेक छेक, अस्, आ, अम्, tame, domesticated
(as a bird or beast); citizen, town-bred, shrewd,
sharp, smart, trained in the acuteness and vice of
towns; (with अनु-प्रास), a kind of alliteration, repe-
tition of two or more consonants in different words;
(अस्), m. a bee.
—छेकोक्ति (˚क-उक्˚), इस्, f. indirect
speech, insinuation, double entendre, hint.
छेकाल or छेकिल, अस्, आ, अम्, = छेक above.
